_comment: Public Convex functions that are intentionally reachable without a signed-in user. Every entry needs a reason and a reviewer. Adding an entry here is how you silence scripts/audit-public-functions.mjs, so keep it tiny and justify each line. See MOSAI pack T0.6.
src/convex/ads/oauth.ts::oauthCallback: Provider redirect target. Caller is not yet authenticated; the request is validated against the single-use state row in oauthStates before any token is stored.
src/convex/social/oauth.ts::socialOauthC: Provider redirect target, same state-row validation as the ads callback.
src/convex/cms.ts::getPublishedByPath: Public read path for a published site: resolves site to page to publishedRevisionId only, so it can never return a draft (CMS-REFERENCE-CONTRACT.md).
